The **Pipe Bolt-Action** is a modular weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The Pipe Bolt-Action Pistol is an improvised weapon consisting of a wooden body with scrap metal, springs, bolts and pipes machine up the working parts of the firearm and the grip. It fires .308 Rounds, loaded into the left side of the gun, with an internal magazine. When modded with a stock, it will be a Pipe Bolt-Action Rifle. While the pipe bolt-action can be a useful weapon, its condition degrades quickly compared to Machined Guns. This quick deterioration is offset by investing in the Licensed Plumber perk.
